value.summary: Adds four new model price entries (qwen/qwen3.8-max, z-ai/glm-5.2, deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash) and three new tests that verify default coverage, GLM-5.2 cost anchoring, cache-rate charging, and argument ordering. The change looks sound — all definitions and contracts are consistent, and the test argument against argument swapping is a good belt-and-suspenders guard for the unit-tested path.
